overall: The AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by posting its Dec. 16, 2024 meeting notice to the website less than 48 hours before the meeting; other allegations were not reached and the Council must release the executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: Council posted its Dec. 16, 2024 meeting notice late; the municipal website did not show it until Friday, Dec. 13, less than 48 hours before the Monday meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, based on the Council’s explanation, we find that the December 16, 2024, meeting notice was not actually posted to the municipal website, the official method of posting notice, for the first time until Friday morning, which was not 48 hours prior to the Monday, December 16, 2024, meeting.

allegations.summary: Notice allegedly failed to list an open session before the executive session topics.
Notice allegedly did not identify the specific litigation matters to be discussed in executive session under Purpose 3.
Council allegedly convened in executive session for an improper purpose on Dec. 16, 2024, under Purpose 3 for a general litigation update.
Council allegedly failed to provide remote access to the Dec. 16, 2024 meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements, with a caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
Within 30 days of the letter, release the December 16, 2024 executive session minutes in their entirety and notify the AG's office that it has done so.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. In addition, we order the Council, within 30 days of the date of this letter, to release the executive session minutes of the meeting held on December 16, 2024, in their entirety and to notify our office that it has done so.
